process.arguments:
-c "set -eu

echo "Starting authorized logical backup"

mariadb-dump \
  --protocol=TCP \
  --host=mariadb-galera.database.svc.cluster.local \
  --port=3306 \
  --user=backupuser \
  --password="$BACKUP_PASSWORD" \
  --single-transaction \
  --skip-lock-tables \
  --skip-add-locks \
  --triggers \
  appdb > /backup/appdb.sql

test -s /backup/appdb.sql

echo "Backup completed successfully"
echo "Backup file: /backup/appdb.sql"

echo "Backup size in bytes:"
wc -c < /backup/appdb.sql

echo "Backup checksum:"
sha256sum /backup/appdb.sql

echo "Database statements found in dump:"
grep -cE '^(CREATE TABLE|INSERT INTO|CREATE.*VIEW)' \
  /backup/appdb.sql || true

echo "First lines of backup:"
head -n 10 /backup/appdb.sql
"
